Specification: This module adapts an underlying Nano specification to make it amenable to TLC model checking. It introduces a model-level hash function state and a helper implementation of hash calculation so that hash assignment can be represented with finite state, and it adds a stuttering action to stop progress gracefully once available hashes are exhausted. The specification verifies safety-related properties by asserting that the overall behavior satisfies both a type invariant and the underlying Nano safety invariant, while using a view that ignores hashFunction and lastHash when hashing states for model checking.
AssumptionNames:
/\ Cardinality(PrivateKey) = Cardinality(PublicKey)
  /\ Cardinality(PrivateKey) <= Cardinality(Node)
  /\ GenesisBalance \in Nat
IfThenElse:
IF \E hash \in Hash : hashFunction[hash] = block
  THEN CHOOSE hash \in Hash : hashFunction[hash] = block
  ELSE CHOOSE hash \in Hash : hashFunction[hash] = N!NoBlock

IF UndefinedHashesExist
  THEN N!Next
  ELSE StutterWhenHashesDepleted
ChoiceExpr:
CHOOSE mapping \in [PrivateKey -> PublicKey] :
        /\ \A publicKey \in PublicKey :
            /\ \E privateKey \in PrivateKey :
                /\ mapping[privateKey] = publicKey

CHOOSE mapping \in [Node -> PrivateKey] :
        /\ \A privateKey \in PrivateKey :
            /\ \E node \in Node :
                /\ mapping[node] = privateKey
